name: Waldmohr (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and black, charged at the top with the arms of Waldmohr (a red lion on white above black and yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Waldmohr; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Waldmohr arms — lion above black and yellow
